high_level_description: The image features an American flag waving in the wind against a clear blue sky. The flag is attached to a tall pole with a gold finial at the top. The flagpole is metallic and appears sturdy, standing prominently in the foreground of the image. Below the flag, there is bold yellow text that reads "TRENDING," which stands out sharply against the dark background. Underneath, in white and yellow text, it states: "U.S. FALLS OUT OF TOP 20 HAPPIEST COUNTRIES FOR THE FIRST TIME EVER." The text is designed to grab attention and convey a significant piece of information
